reasoning.step1:
1) Document classification
- Contains header "Rechnung" and invoice number "RE073891 vom 08.11.2023" → qualifies as invoice.
- No exclusion keywords ("Zahlungserinnerung", "Mahnung", etc.) in prominent positions → not excluded.

2) Locate invoice date
- Found near invoice number: "RE073891                vom        08.11.2023" → Invoice.Date = "08.11.2023".

3) Identify sender VAT ID
- Company footer shows "ATU78657801 • FN 586 642 i ..." and company name FEIFAR BEFESTIGUNGSTECHNIK GMBH → Sender.VatId = "ATU78657801".
- Note: customer VAT "ATU64131246" appears near top but labeled as Kunde; per schema Sender.VatId must be sender's VAT → choose ATU78657801.

4) Find net, VAT rate, VAT amount, grand total
- Line "Warenwert:                                                                        413,86       EUR" → Net.Amount = 413,86.
- Line "zuzüglich         20%      MWSt                      413,86                                         82,77      EUR" → Vat.Rate = 20, Vat.Amount = 82,77. Confirm VAT refers to whole invoice (applies to Warenwert).
- Line "ENDBETRAG:                                                                             496,63       EUR" → GrandTotal.Amount = 496,63.

5) Numeric formatting decisions
- Input uses comma as decimal separator. Per schema values are numbers and must preserve decimal places from input; convert to numeric form with same decimals using dot as decimal separator for JSON numbers:
  - Net.Amount -> 413.86
  - Vat.Amount -> 82.77
  - GrandTotal.Amount -> 496.63
  - Vat.Rate -> 20 (no percent symbol)

6) No inference applied
- All extracted fields are explicitly present. If any field had been missing, it would be left empty per rules.

7) Multiple occurrences
- Only one invoice-level VAT rate/group present; use that single group.
